scripts.build: node scripts/check-env.mjs && astro build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-lct-collect 'vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts'
scripts.test:ci: npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:reminders
scripts.emulators: node scripts/prepare-reminder-emulator.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-lct-collect
scripts.test:smoke: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-lct-collect "npm run seed:emulators && tsx scripts/smoke-emulators.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/prepare-reminder-emulator.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-lct-collect "LCT_SEED_MEMBERS=820 node --import tsx scripts/seed-emulators.ts && playwright test"
scripts.test:reminders: node scripts/prepare-reminder-emulator.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-lct-collect "npm run seed:emulators && LCT_REMINDER_TESTS=true vitest run tests/reminder-api.test.ts"
